claim_or_interpretation_to_audit: DAFs increase individual giving; 50000 switchers increased recorded gifts over 10x
observed_evidence: Within 54 participant nonprofit CRM datasets, switchers' reported giving to those nonprofits rose
explicit_or_shadow_assumption: Observed increase equals new total charitable generosity attributable to DAF
material_alternatives_and_limitations: Selection into DAF, wealth shocks, one-time gifts, channel shifts, retiming, nonprofits not all recipients
currently_justified_conclusion: Association in selected recipients, not causal increase in total donor philanthropy
fastest_discriminating_test: Acquire linked donor total giving including outside-recipients plus matched non-switcher event study
reassessment_trigger: Counterfactual control shows sustained higher total philanthropy beyond recipients and timing

claim_or_interpretation_to_audit: DAFs are the fastest-growing giving vehicle; median DAF channel +75pct vs non-DAF +9pct
observed_evidence: Median growth for sampled nonprofit DAF vs non-DAF revenue 2021-2025
explicit_or_shadow_assumption: Selected CRM channel growth ranks all charitable vehicles nationally
material_alternatives_and_limitations: Selection of 54 participating nonprofits, differing starting bases, DAF uptake, attribution changes
currently_justified_conclusion: Sampled nonprofit DAF revenue grew faster than sampled nonDAF revenue; no national rank established
fastest_discriminating_test: Replicate on national channels with consistent donor/vehicle unit and sample weights
reassessment_trigger: Broader representative source confirms category ranking across all giving vehicles

claim_or_interpretation_to_audit: DAF donors retained 13 percentage points more than other donors
observed_evidence: Observed recipient-specific retention difference in selected nonprofit CRM files
explicit_or_shadow_assumption: DAF adoption causally increases donor loyalty or increases platform NRR
material_alternatives_and_limitations: Higher-wealth donors, large existing donor relationships, better CRM donor matching
currently_justified_conclusion: Recipient retention correlation in selected organizations, not sponsor/vendor customer retention or causal treatment effect
fastest_discriminating_test: Match donor history/wealth/recency and compare pre-trends and future retention
reassessment_trigger: Controlled matched cohort identifies incremental donor retention, with sensitivity to identity matching

claim_or_interpretation_to_audit: Two thirds of DAF grants under 1000 dollars
observed_evidence: Gift-count distribution in the 54-nonprofit recipient sample
explicit_or_shadow_assumption: All 3.59m DAF accounts have small balances or small grants dominate dollars
material_alternatives_and_limitations: Grant-count vs dollar-weight vs sponsor-account denominators differ; selected recipients differ
currently_justified_conclusion: Small DAF gifts appear common in these recipient records; balance distribution and national volume unknown
fastest_discriminating_test: Join grant frequency/amount bins by sponsor and recipient with weighted representative sample
reassessment_trigger: National recipient study confirms grant-count ratio across sponsor types
